The '''Inner Sanctum''' was two unused chambers located in a neglected secondary line of the [[Eyar City Sewer]]'s [[Southcentral Branch]]. The [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] recluse and [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Sizinnian]] took over the chambers and made it his living and work area, a place where he could contemplate and dissect the philosophical text known as the ''[[Journey of the Minds]]''. The inner chamber was used as storage, crammed full of several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] worth of long-term [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]] and ready-made meals. The outer chamber contained Sizinnian's living area, including his work area and sleeping mattress.<ref name="HS" />
